import { expect, Locator, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { BasePage } from './BasePage';

export class __PAGE_CLASS__ extends BasePage {
    static readonly PATH = '__RELATIVE_PATH__';

    private readonly title: Locator;
    private readonly keyContainer: Locator;

    constructor(page: Page) {
        super(page, '__PAGE_CLASS__');
        this.title = page.locator('[data-test="title"]');
        this.keyContainer = page.locator('__KEY_CONTAINER_SELECTOR__');
    }

    async open(): Promise<void> {
        await this.goto(__PAGE_CLASS__.PATH);
        await this.assertLoaded();
    }

    async assertLoaded(): Promise<void> {
        await expect(this.title).toBeVisible();
        await expect(this.keyContainer).toBeVisible();
        await expect(this.page).toHaveURL(/__URL_REGEX__/);
    }

    // Add action methods and read methods based on captured DOM.
}
